name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x ↔ x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ↔ (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.cut s x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_apply_mem
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  ∀ p ∈ s, RealizationBoundaries.cut s x p = x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_apply_not_mem
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  ∀ p ∉ s, RealizationBoundaries.cut s x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.exceptional_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → (RealizationBoundaries.exceptional m).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_nsmul
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), (m • x) p = ↑m * x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_cast_eq_zero
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑m = 0 ↔ ↑p ∣ m

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_eq_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero
type: ∀ {m : ℕ} {x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient} (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ¬↑p ∣ m → (m • x) p = 0 → x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_of_nsmul
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.exists_annihilator_of_finiteSupport
type: ∀ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport, ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsion_iff_finiteSupport
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_support
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t) ⊆
    RealizationBoundaries.exceptional (r.den * t.den)

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_finite
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_zero
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_symmetric
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t = RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t r

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_neg
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (-r) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t v : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (r + t) v =
    RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t v + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (t + v)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S x + RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S y

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_bijective
type: ∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime}, S.Infinite → Function.Bijective (RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) z =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y z)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_comm
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (0, 0) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_inverse
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (-x.1, -x.2) = (0, 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_not_removable
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → ¬∃ b, ∀ (r t : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + b r + b t - b (r + t) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_zero_of_divisible
type:
∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup E],
  (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (x : E), ∃ y, m • y = x) → ∀ (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.not_injective_hom_of_divisible
type:
∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup E] [Nontrivial E],
  (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (x : E), ∃ y, m • y = x) → ∀ (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), ¬Function.Injective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.rational_hom_zero
type: ∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℚ E] (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection_surjective
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Function.Surjective ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection_ker
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).ker = RealizationBoundaries.finiteKernel W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (w : ↥W),
  w ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (s : ↥W →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s ≠ AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section_of_nontrivial
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) [Nontrivial ↥W],
  ¬∃ s, (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.divisorPrime_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Finite (RealizationBoundaries.DivisorPrime m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.divisorCoordinates_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Finite (RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension_finite
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
      RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap_surjective
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → Function.Surjective ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m ↔ ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap_ker
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m).ker = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv_mk
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm) ↑x = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_of_same_prime_divisors
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    0 < n →
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m ↔ ↑p ∣ n) →
        RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateRestriction_map
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ∣ n) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateRestriction hmn) ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W n) x) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_target_kills_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Fintype F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (Fintype.card F) ≤ f.ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_target_coordinate_kernel
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Fintype F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W (Fintype.card F)).ker ≤ f.ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.toPair_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).toPair = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x.toPair y.toPair

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.rational_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).rational = x.rational + y.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.finite_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).finite = x.finite + y.finite + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.rational y.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv_coe
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (hS : S.Infinite) (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS) x) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.rational + ↑x.finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeAt_injective
type: Function.Injective RealizationBoundaries.primeAt

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex_bounds
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  2 * n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n ∧ RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n < 2 * n + 2

name: RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex_bounds
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  2 * n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n ∧ RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n < 2 * n + 2

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex_injective
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Function.Injective (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector_infinite
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a).Infinite

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosen_mem
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a

name: RealizationBoundaries.omitted_not_mem
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_prime_root_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (∃ y, ↑p • y = RealizationBoundaries.markedElement S) ↔ p ∉ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosen_prime_obstructs
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  ¬∃ y,
      ↑(RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n)) • y =
        RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.omitted_prime_has_root
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  ∃ y,
    ↑(RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n)) • y =
      RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_le_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.nsmul_mem_preimage_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambient_root_iff
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ y, m • y = x) ↔ ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_root_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (∃ y, m • y = x) ↔ ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_pure
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), (∃ y, m • y = ↑x) → ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.prime_obstruction
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p ≠ 0 → ¬∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_torsion_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ ↑x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nonzero_coordinate
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), x ≠ 0 → ∃ p, ↑x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = 0 ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_iff
type:
∀ (x y : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap y ↔
    x - y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.division_defect_finite
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • RealizationBoundaries.coordinateDivide m x - x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_surjective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Surjective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_injective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Injective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_bijective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Bijective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_to_divisibleHull_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑(DivisibleHull.coeAddMonoidHom RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_rational_module_unique
type: Subsingleton (_root_.Module ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_denominator_clear
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), m • (↑m)⁻¹ • v = v

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_mem
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} {p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  p ∈ S → RealizationBoundaries.indicator S p = 1

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_not_mem
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} {p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  p ∉ S → RealizationBoundaries.indicator S p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.support_indicator
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = S

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_tail_ne_zero
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_zero
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_one
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 1 = RealizationBoundaries.indicator S

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_neg
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (-r) = -RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ∣ r.den → RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_defect
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  r.den • RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r - r.num • RealizationBoundaries.indicator S ∈
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_rationalSection
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r) =
    r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_selectorGroup_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S ↔
    ∃ r, r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_mem
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_exists
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  ∃ r d, ↑x = RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_unique
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite →
    ∀ (r t : ℚ) (d e : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d = RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + ↑e → r = t ∧ d = e
